definition: Quits the current window, if nothing is unsaved.
quote: Everybody's first question in here is how to leave. Colon, q, Enter. It only closes the door you're standing in, though.

definition: Quits and throws away every unsaved change.
quote: The exclamation mark means: I know, do it anyway. Use it when you broke something and want it gone.

definition: Starts typing before the cursor; Esc goes back to moving.
quote: In here, letters are commands until you ask to type. Press i, write, then Esc. Forget the Esc and you'll write commands into the wall.
opposite: Esc always brings you back to Normal mode.

quote: Quitting doesn't get you out. Saving does. Write your name into the process table, or GC will file you under garbage.
opposite: :w saves without quitting; ZZ does the same as :wq.

definition: Moves one cell: h left, j down, k up, l right.
quote: Arrow keys are for tourists. Keep your fingers home: j looks like an arrow pointing down, if you squint.
opposite: Counts multiply them later: 5j moves five lines.

definition: Jumps to the start of the next word. b jumps back, e to a word's end.
quote: Walking cell by cell through RAM is how I wore out two keyboards. Jump word to word instead.
opposite: b jumps back a word; e lands on the end of one.

definition: Jumps to the next WORD: anything up to a space, punctuation included.
quote: Small w stops at every dot and dash. Capital W ignores them and only stops at spaces.
opposite: B and E are the capital versions of b and e.

definition: Jumps to the last character of the line.
quote: You could press l forty times. Or press $ once and go get a coffee.
opposite: 0 jumps to the very start; ^ to the first letter.

definition: Jumps to the last line. gg jumps to the first.
quote: Long files feel endless until you learn G. Bottom of the file in one key, top again with gg.

definition: A number before a motion repeats it: 3w jumps three words.
quote: Counting is cheaper than pressing. Type the number first, then the move.
opposite: It works with almost every motion: 4j, 2e, 10l.
